primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants with NASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis at Week 52.
efficacy_outcome: NASH resolution without worsening fibrosis: 16.7% (50 mg), 14.3% (100 mg), and 17.6% (300 mg) vs 5.9% with placebo; respective p-values 0.3504, 0.3730, and 0.1428.
safety_signal: Adverse events occurred in 70.2–76.1% of MK-3655 participants vs 77.3% with placebo; serious AEs affected 1/45, 1/47, and 1/46 participants across MK-3655 doses vs 8/44 with placebo. Discontinuations due to AEs were 2.2%, 0%, and 0% vs 0%; no deaths.
